Dave Matthews Band
November 19, 2024
Mohegan Sun Arena
Uncasville, CT

Taper:		Steven Walkuski (<email>)
Source:		Beyerdynamic MC930 (Cardioids) > Lunatec V3 (Digital out)> Tascam HD-P2 (recorded as 24-bit/44.1kHz, resampled to 16-bit)
Location:	Stage left, back of the pit, in line with the stack
Conversion:	Adobe Audition 2024 > CD Wave Editor V1.98 to flac, level 8
Mixing:		Scooped the bass -5dB at 60Hz, various volume adjustments to amplify
